commits.body: Job 20261107-032249 ran the 533 own-checker benchmark runs in 2m23s; the step exited 1 because conformance/leadingZerosLong/2 gets a spurious violation (witness 48, the JVM says it holds) in all three modes. The phasesExcess and slowdown comparison was skipped, though 0 of 533 runs carry phasesExcess in the saved JSON.
